llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomechanical modeling, implant design analysis, stress shielding quantification, or finite element analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨医院手术量与全髋关节置换翻修风险的关系。
summary_zh.method: 采用北欧关节成形术注册数据库进行人口学队列研究。
summary_zh.result: 低手术量医院与较高翻修风险显著相关。
summary_zh.validation: 基于大规模多中心注册数据的统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the association between hospital procedure volume and risk of revision after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A population-based cohort study using the Nordic Arthroplasty Register Association database.
summary_en.result: Lower hospital volume was associated with a significantly higher risk of revision.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of registry data from multiple countries.
